fact: The higher committee of the Intilaqa project held its periodic meeting at the Civil Status Authority's headquarters in Tripoli to follow up the updating of the civil registers and the use of modern technology to speed transactions, chaired by the head of the Authority, Major General Tariq Hamouda al-Thaman, who is also the project's director general; no office count, plan document or source of finance is given.
title: «مشروع الانطلاقة» تتابع تحديث السجلات المدنية وتسريع الأعمال
